title: Reason. Part 1
note: Silent. Frame 1 fully composed, no fade, ONE strip (hook, 0-3.0, y=345, white price-gun sticker with red border). Department-store returns line under a RETURNS sign, bright. Two large faces: his phone lit mid-swipe (generic profile-card glow, no UI; thumb flicks 0.2-1.4), her phone lit too (coral case). The biggest, brightest object: the yellow return slip on a clipboard on the line rail between them, 'REASON FOR RETURN: ____', his navy pen on a chain hovering over the box. Season opener: no take 1, no rewind. Own payoff before the cliff: she reads his lie, spots the tags, he is caught, her own confession 'i cancelled twice.' and one shared laugh (15.1), then both phones go in their bags (16.4, 16.9). Cliff: his turn at the counter, ONE LINE ONLY sign, the clerk slides a fresh slip, he gulps, she raises a brow; scanner-beam wipe to the vote board by 24.8 s. Whenever the slip carries a line it is a WHOLE-FRAME insert (slip ~800 px wide, centred around y=760, Caveat 700 pen drawn in; his navy ALL CAPS, hers teal lowercase; no parentheses; 18 characters per line max). Text only between y=270 and y=1250. No NoSwipe mention. No real store or place names. Joke is on him (a first date he cancelled himself); she is warm and equal with her own honest line; never 'she ghosted me'. Clerk is an adult, silent, deadpan. Strips are first person. Part 1 only: no rewind, no VOID stamp.

choices.why: Both about him. A is the safe line he already tried, B the honest one. B is the planned winner. Part 2 plays A first and fails on him (the clerk stamps NOT MY SIZE and hands him the same shirt a size up), VOID stamp and reversed beam as the rewind, then B carries on.

strips.text: the stranger in the returns line swipes too.
she caught me swiping. now she's reading my return slip.
I'm returning a shirt. tags still on.
the box asked why. I played it safe.
she read it. then she saw the tags.
I bought it for a first date. then I bailed.
phones went in the bag. both of us.
the line moved. we didn't mind.
the clerk wants one line. what do I write?
